reconcile.note: Henry reads Luke's 'all' in Acts 1:1 as summarizing the main heads of Jesus's ministry, not a literal complete record, the same limit John himself concedes.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists this as a flat contradiction, weighing Luke's claim to cover 'all' Jesus did against John's own admission most went unwritten.

sides.snippet: even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written
sides.verseText: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.

sides.snippet: concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach
sides.verseText: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
